name: Blue Ruins  ~Harukanaru Bibanon no Hihou~
original_name: ＢＬＵＥ ＲＵＩＮＳ ～遥かなるビバノンの秘宝～
source:
Rusty is an archaeologist who travels with his magician sister Wiki. Together they arrive to the town Nimrud in search of information about blue ruins and its treasures.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-april-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
拉斯蒂是一名考古学家，与魔法师妹妹维姬结伴旅行。两人一同抵达尼姆鲁德镇，寻找关于蓝色遗迹及其宝藏的情报。
